def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; a=np.array(g); h,w=a.shape
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    m=a==8
    rs=[i for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if m[i,j]]; cs=[j for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if m[i,j]]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs); sh,sw=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    key=[(i,j,int(a[i,j])) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if a[i,j] not in (0,8)]
    kr0,kr1=min(p[0] for p in key),max(p[0] for p in key); kc0,kc1=min(p[1] for p in key),max(p[1] for p in key)
    K=np.zeros((kr1-kr0+1,kc1-kc0+1),int)
    for i,j,v in key: K[i-kr0,j-kc0]=v
    R=np.rot90(K,k=-1)  # CW
    Rh,Rw=R.shape
    sy,sx=sh//Rh,sw//Rw
    big=np.zeros((sh,sw),int)
    for i in range(Rh):
        for j in range(Rw):
            big[i*sy:(i+1)*sy, j*sx:(j+1)*sx]=R[i,j]
    for i in range(sh):
        for j in range(sw):
            if m[r0+i,c0+j] and big[i,j]: out[r0+i][c0+j]=int(big[i,j])
    return out
